items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: the Dean, Carl Nosse, came out at intermission and said, “I’m going to give a presentation to Dave and Iola.”

ctx.x: Well you said it the best, where you said rhythm ties humanity together. Am I correct? Absolutely. Amazing story. And you are one of the real ambassadors. We’re most appreciative that you’ve done that in your lifetime. I’m really interested to hear about your vision for the Institute.

Oh yeah. Well again, it’s just grown beyond what we ever thought would happen. It started from me playing at the University of the Pacific. And before the concert the kids from the conservatory could ask me questions. And one of them said, “where did you © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

meet your wife?” And I was in the old conservatory where I’d been in 1938 to ’42 and I said, “coming through that door.” It’s the same auditorium. Because I didn’t say hello or anything, but I remembered seeing her and I asked years later, I said I can tell you what you were wearing. She said that’s right. So the next time we played there, it’s a long story about the dress, because why she would remember, her parents lived and moved to Stockton, California. Because she was a scholarship student and they couldn’t…
